CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT SHARMA  OR % 18.12.2023 1.

The present application under Section 438 of the CrPC seeks anticipatory bail in case FIR No.
474/2022, under Sections 354/376/506 of the IPC and Section 8 of the POCSO Act, registered at P.S. Pinjore, Panchkula, Haryana, which has been currently transferred to P.S. Jaitpur, New Delhi.
2.
It is pointed out that chargesheet in the present FIR has been filed before the Court of competent jurisdiction.

3. In view thereof, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant seeks leave to withdraw the present application with liberty to move appropriate application seeking bail before the learned Trial Court where the chargesheet stands filed.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 20/12/2023 at 22:50:52 4.
Leave and liberty granted.
